summary.text: The owner token is distinct from the guest token. It appears before Hei Lou Lan when he first enters Imperial Court blessed land and marks his status there.

claims.text: Inside the fifty-fourth round, Hei Lou Lan takes out a token and waves it at the sky. This token is different from the guest token: it is the owner token. It vibrates, ripples form in the air, and dozens of fish enslavement Gu of rank one, two, and three appear for the round.

The owner token is generally held by the alliance leader. It self-destructs once it leaves Imperial Court blessed land. While Fang Yuan is in the treasure room, he also has to leave if the possessor of the owner token walks out of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.
Hei Lou Lan wants Huang Jin tribes to cooperate in getting through the rounds. Each round he passes would allow the owner token with him to advance and make later progress more convenient.

Hei Lou Lan uses his owner token while watching Gu Masters enter the tower. Information sent by the owner token tells him that the first thirty rounds have been gotten through in a short time because of the enormous quantity of Gu Masters.

After a descendant of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable passes a floor, the owner token advances into a one-edge owner token. That holder can grasp control of a floor and enter the treasure room to take a treasure without exchanging. If the descendant passes ten floors, the owner token becomes a ten-edges owner token and can retrieve a Giant Sun inheritance from the treasure room. Owner tokens can mutually annex each other.
If Hei Lou Lan cannot clear the floor, he would only have an ordinary edgeless owner token. Clearing it is what he needs for a one-edge owner token.

When the flying bear phantom round ends, he takes out his owner token and an edge gradually emerges from the originally round token. A sense of fortune tells him he is in full control of that floor. As master of the owner token, the round’s reward is his, and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building’s power lets him refine it on contact.
